Questions

What is the median annual wage for Civil engineers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Civil Engineers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $100,160.

What is the hourly median for Civil engineers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Civil Engineers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $48.16.

How many Civil engineers work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 9,760 wage-and-salary Civil Engineers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Civil engineers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.91. Values above 1.00 mean Civil Engineers are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Civil engineers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Civil Engineers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $106,540.

How does Chicago's Civil engineers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($100,160) is $310 lower than Austin ($100,470) and $16,320 lower than Seattle ($116,480). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
